adminShiftplan.title: Shift plan booking rules
adminShiftplan.subtitle: Control month windows, specific days, and blocked booking types per project. Control whether agents see the 15-minute grid while planning.
adminShiftplan.scopeHint: Rules apply to all teams and agents in the selected project.
adminShiftplan.monthRulesHint: Open or close calendar bookings for the whole month (sick “K” stays bookable when closed).
adminShiftplan.monthBookingOpen: Calendar booking open for this month
adminShiftplan.agentVisibilityHint: Hidden: agents see no 15-minute grid until published. Visible while planning: agents see live data. Published: normal.
adminShiftplan.dayOverrideHint: Open or close individual days (overrides the month setting for that date).
adminShiftplan.typeBlockHint: e.g. block early shift or other types for the month or a single day.

adminSchichtplanerAccess.title: Shift planner access
adminSchichtplanerAccess.subtitle: For users with system role “Schichtplanung”: pick Dienstleister, Abteilungen, projects, and teams they may see. This is stored as a dedicated access role (roster day/month only inside the resulting project set).
adminSchichtplanerAccess.loadHint: Users with the Schichtplanung role appear here. Create them under Users if the list is empty.
adminSchichtplanerAccess.emptySelection: Nothing selected — the planner will see no projects (empty roster).

policy.lead: Vacation must be booked at least {days} days ahead.
policy.currentMonth: Vacation in current month: {allowed, select, true {allowed} other {locked}}.

level1.title: Controlling – Level 1 (live)
level1.subtitle: Pick department, project and teams, then set A/P/N only for the current time block.
level1.openBoardHint: Create a session to load the board.
level1.blockInfo: Current block index: {block} (max. {lastIndex}), block length {minutes} min (Europe/Berlin)
level1.readOnly: View only: edits are limited to the live block on today’s date.

end.title: Final review
end.subtitle: All live data and level-2 status; hour adjustments (delta).

leadership.title: Leadership dashboard
leadership.subtitle: KPIs for projects and teams in your access scope.
leadership.scopeBody: Figures follow your access roles (project scopes). Unrestricted org-wide data is for administrators without scoped roles.

agentWorkspace.name: Name
agentWorkspace.salesEntryOnlySubtitle: Entry only: log contracts and manage your rows. Analytics live under KPI.
agentWorkspace.bookingSubtitle: Book shifts, vacation and sick days per date.
agentWorkspace.myMonthSubtitle: Billing view from roster, calendar, requests and sales.
agentWorkspace.shiftplanHiddenBody: Your calendar preferences are stored. The shift plan for this month is not published yet or is being edited.
agentWorkspace.shiftplanScrollHint: Scroll sideways to see every 15-minute slot — nothing is hidden.
agentWorkspace.dashSubtitle: At-a-glance figures, announcements, and shortcuts to your tools.
agentWorkspace.dashAnnouncementsHint: Org-wide notices that are still valid (no expiry or not yet expired).
agentWorkspace.dashQuickLinksHint: Jump straight into each workspace — behaviour is unchanged.
agentWorkspace.dashCardCalendar: Book shifts, vacation, and sick days.
agentWorkspace.calendarDayClosed: This day is closed for bookings. Only sick leave (K) is allowed.
agentWorkspace.calendarTypeBlocked: This booking type is blocked for the selected period.
agentWorkspace.dashCardKpi: Sales, CR by category (calls import), and quality from CSV.
agentWorkspace.kpiSubtitle: Sales figures from your entry plus raw imports (quality + CR calls per category).
agentWorkspace.kpiSalesSectionHint: Premiums and quantities from sales entry; calls and CR from the category CSV import (KPI_CATEGORY_DAILY).
agentWorkspace.kpiSalesEmpty: No sales entries for this month.
agentWorkspace.kpiSalesCrHint: Calls come from raw CSV import. CR numerator: optional “conversions” column; otherwise your sales entry count per product category (matched case-insensitively). CR = numerator ÷ calls.
agentWorkspace.kpiSalesCrEmpty: No category rows yet: import CSV type KPI_CATEGORY_DAILY (columns email, date, category, calls, optional conversions).
agentWorkspace.kpiQualitySectionHint: Daily values from the KPI CSV import (raw data). Without an import this section stays empty.
agentWorkspace.kpiQualityCsvEuroHint: The “salesEuro” field from the quality import — separate from sales entry.
agentWorkspace.kpiQualityByDayHint: One row per imported calendar day.
agentWorkspace.kpiQualityEmpty: No imported quality data for this month.
